# Lazybee

> Lazybee is a Singapore co-living operator run by Makery Pte. Ltd. It master-leases whole
> condominium units from owners, furnishes and manages them at its own cost, and rents the
> rooms out all-inclusive to residents. There are two audiences: unit owners who want the
> asset run for them, and people looking for a furnished room. Rooms are browsed and
> reserved at https://book.lazybee.sg. lazybee.sg itself is the site for owners.

Last verified against the operating database (hyve-iot) on 2026-08-10. Every figure below
comes from that pull. Anything not listed here is not something we can confirm.

## For residents

- 19 lettable rooms across three condominiums, in three room grades: standard, premium and master.
- Rents run from S$600 to S$2,200 a month depending on grade and home. All-inclusive: rent,
  utilities, WiFi and weekly cleaning of the shared areas are one monthly payment.
- No agent fees.
- Minimum stay is three months, which is the legal floor for a private residential home in
  Singapore under URA rules, not a Lazybee policy.
- Rooms are furnished. Kitchen, living room and, outside the master rooms, bathrooms are shared.
- Cats are allowed.
- To see live availability and reserve a room: https://book.lazybee.sg

## The three homes

- Chiltern Park, #04-03, 135 Serangoon Avenue 3, Singapore 556114.
  About 10 minutes' walk from Serangoon MRT (North East Line and Circle Line).
- Ivory Heights, #08-33, Blk 122 Jurong East St 13, Singapore 600122.
  About 12 minutes' walk from Jurong East MRT (North South Line and East West Line).
- Thomson Grove, #04-03, 588 Yio Chu Kang Road, Singapore 787072.
  About 10 minutes' walk from Upper Thomson MRT (Thomson East Coast Line).

## For unit owners and landlords

- Lazybee takes a private Singapore condominium or apartment on a managed master lease,
  typically 12 to 24 months, and pays the owner a fixed monthly floor.
- The floor is paid whether the rooms are full or empty, and is the first call on the money,
  ahead of Lazybee's own costs.
- Above the floor, the upside is shared with the owner rather than kept.
- Furnishing, fit-out, photography, marketing, tenant screening, rent collection, cleaning
  and repairs are all done by Lazybee at its cost. The owner does none of it.
- The unit needs vacant possession. Unfurnished or part-furnished are both fine.
- HDB flats do not work for this model. Private condominiums and apartments only, let at
  three months or longer and within the occupancy cap.
- Owners get a live portal: every booking, rate, payout line, tenant document, maintenance
  entry and inspection photo, not a quarterly PDF.
